'''Captain of the Gold''' is a naval rank in the [[Ever Victorious Army]] of the [[Seanchan]].

[[Egeanin Tamarath]]'s mother was a Captain of the Gold, and was later raised to Hand of the Empress at Sea as a ''[[so'jhin]]'' to the Empress herself.<ref name="comp">''[[The Wheel of Time Companion]]'', Egeanin Tamarath.</ref>
